name: Asahina Natsume
source:
Birth Date: 1986/01/01.

Natsume is the 7th son and one of the triplets. Unlike [url=/c12972]Azusa[/url] and [url=/c10558]Tsubaki[/url], he is a fraternal triplet. He is the CEO of a game company that makes one of [url=/c10574]Ema[/url]'s favorite games, "Zombie Hazard". Unlike the rest of the brothers, he lives alone. He has a blunt way of talking but is very good at looking after others.

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brothers_Conflict#Characters]Wikipedia[/url].]
